runtime_policy: Only the exact reviewed current qa.py is accepted; historical QA bytes remain evidence but are rejected as a current runtime because they can cite a contradictory answer.

external_policy_limit: No independent signer or contract-owner mechanism was found in the repository; any external organizational policy was not asserted by this artifact.
